readerEvidence.summary: Single-pass Astra recovery of all twelve supplied English official keys for the Bulgarian 2016 theory edition. Personally visually read all ten Bulgarian statement pages and Bulgarian instruction page in solutions51; reused exact-byte original key and alternate-key pages personally read in solutions47 and constants in solutions50, with hash-bound checkpoints. Retains twelve original whole-problem IDs, native Exoplanets sections, original Bulgarian statements and English solutions/rubrics. No independent model checker.
sourceGaps: Referenced blank Summary Answersheets and Cover Sheet are absent from the inspected archived source inventory. All twelve supplied official worked keys are recovered.
sourceDiscrepancies: Bulgarian T3.2 describes radiation in the early Universe at 2.723 K; the English question/key describes the present epoch. Original Bulgarian wording and English calculation retained.
Bulgarian T12.3 asks the maximum inclination; English question/key asks the minimum and gives i >= arccos(R_s/a). Both printed versions retained without substituting a correction.
Bulgarian T7.4 has no printed point box. Its points remain null; the Bulgarian instructions explicitly assign 20 points to each of T6–T10 and 250 total.
The Bulgarian instructions specify 12 questions/250 points, unlike the thirteen/300 in the English instruction edition inspected in solutions47. Only the matching Bulgarian instructions are attached.

Printed numerical/formula discrepancies are retained: T8 uses c/lambda_max for nu_max and prints 1233 pi then 3813; T9 numerical velocity denominator lacks a power of ten and the stated semimajor axis is 20933 km; T11.4 prints a direct rather than inverse mass ratio in the radius-cubed relation; T11.7 prose says 166.67 Hz while its mass calculation uses 142.86 Hz. No inferred corrections are substituted.
The primary Exoplanets key has a check mark on the third transit sketch; the alternate full key omits that mark. Primary source image retained.
